context: Two teens swap school anecdotes after class
purpose: Teach: 犯し/払わ/許す/かわいそう/始末/はずれ/目立っ/見かける

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ねえ聞いて、今日うちのクラスの田中、また大きなミスを犯したんだよ。
lines.en: Hey listen, Tanaka in my class messed up big again today.
lines.style: Excited teen girl sharing school gossip energetically with friend

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: またあいつか。先生の話に注意を払わずに寝てたんでしょ?
lines.en: Him again? He probably wasn't paying attention and fell asleep, right?
lines.style: Casual teen boy responding with knowing sarcastic tone naturally

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: それがさ、テストの予想が全部はずれて、答案がほぼ白紙で目立ってたの。ちょっとかわいそうだったよ。
lines.en: So his test guesses were all wrong, his paper was basically blank and stood out. Kinda pitiful.
lines.style: Animated teen storytelling with mix of amusement and sympathy

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うわ、先生はそれを許すわけないよね。後始末どうすんの?
lines.en: Whoa, the teacher won't let that slide. How's he gonna clean up the mess?
lines.style: Teen boy reacting with grimace and genuine curious concern

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 放課後ずっと残されてた。廊下で時々見かけるたびに、しょぼくれてるの。
lines.en: He got kept after school. Every time I spot him in the hall he looks deflated.
lines.style: Teen girl describing scene with vivid casual storytelling rhythm

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: そういえばうちの部活も大変でさ、新しい部員が全然来なくて。
lines.en: Speaking of which, my club's struggling too, no new members at all.
lines.style: Teen boy shifting topic with slight sigh of fatigue

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 短期間でなんとかなるよ。ポスターとか作って、トピック面白くすればいいじゃん。
lines.en: You can fix it quickly. Just make posters and pick interesting topics.
lines.style: Upbeat teen girl giving cheerful encouraging practical advice

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: だな。期待が高まるようなやつ作ってみる。サンキュー、さくら。
lines.en: Yeah. I'll make one that builds up excitement. Thanks, Sakura.
lines.style: Teen boy responding with renewed motivation and casual gratitude
